messages.content: You are a precise information extraction system. You only output valid JSON.

Extract entities and events from the document below.

Entity types: Person, Organization, Location, Building, Product, Art, Other

Event types and their argument roles:
- Attack: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Consequence
- Military_operation: roles = Agent, Patient, Location
- Conquering: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Name
- Killing: roles = Killer, Victim, Location, Cause, Instrument
- Death: roles = Agent, Cause, Location, Instrument
- Bodily_harm: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Cause
- Catastrophe: roles = Patient, Location, Loss, Content
- Destroying: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Damaging: roles = Agent, Patient, Location, Loss
- Statement: roles = Speaker, Message, Location, Details
- Change_of_leadership: roles = New_leader, Old_leader, Location, Selector, New_Occupation, Old_Occupation
- Arriving: roles = Agent, Location

Rules:
1. Copy every entity mention, trigger and argument exactly as it appears in the document.
2. List every entity mention (including repeated mentions of the same entity).
3. Create one event entry for every trigger occurrence of the event types above. Ignore other kinds of events.
4. Arguments may appear anywhere in the document, not only in the trigger's sentence. Omit roles with no argument.

Return a JSON object in exactly this format:
{
  "entities": [
    {
      "text": "<entity mention copied from the text>",
      "type": "<entity type>"
    }
  ],
  "events": [
    {
      "trigger": "<word or short phrase in the text that signals the event>",
      "type": "<event type>",
      "arguments": {
        "<role>": [
          "<argument span copied from the text>"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Document:
The Battle of Lovcha , `` or Loftcha '' ( today Lovech ) , was a battle of the Russo-Turkish War ( 1877–1878 ) which occurred during the siege of Plevna . Russian forces successfully reduced the fortress at Lovcha , which had protected Plevna 's communication and supply lines . In July 1877 , shortly after the siege of Plevna began , the garrison 's commander , Osman Pasha , received 15 battalions of reinforcements from Sofia . He chose to use these reinforcements to fortify Lovcha , which protected his lines of support running from Orchanie to Plevna . After the failure of the first two attempts to storm the city of Plevna , the Russians brought up significant reinforcements , and the investing army now totaled 100,000 . Intent on cutting Osman 's communications and supply lines , General Alexander Imerentinsky was sent out with 22,703 Russian troops to seize Lovcha . On September 1 Generals Alexander Imerentinsky , Mikhail Skobelev , and Vladimir Dobrowolski reached Lovcha and attacked the city . Fighting continued for the next two days . Osman marched out of Plevna to the relief of Lovcha , but on September 3 , before he could reach Lovcha , it fell to the Russians . Survivors of the battle withdrew into Plevna and were organized into 3 battalions . After the loss of Lovcha , these additional troops brought Osman 's force up to 30,000 , the largest it would be during the siege . The Russians settled on the strategy of a complete investment of Plevna , and with the loss of its major supply route , the fall of Plevna was inevitable .
